technical.summary: Strong intermediate momentum with golden cross and new highs, but extreme overbought conditions and long-term downtrend create pullback risk; suitable for risk-managed swing entry with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 28 days create a low-conviction setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no directional signal; market fear (44 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 217.76 crisis regime, macro_score -7) with imminent NFP event in 2 days creates hostile trading environment; earnings in 28 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross (EMA 20/50), new 20-day highs, and supertrend bullish signal intermediate momentum with price near 52-week highs offering contrarian opportunity in fear-zone market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis regime 217.76), imminent NFP event in 2 days, earnings risk in 28 days, RSI/Stoch extreme overbought (85+/86+), and price below EMA-200/SMA-200 create hostile environment with pullback risk into support at 207.20.
